title: Reverse a string
prompt:
Write `reverse(s: &str) -> String` that returns the text backwards.

```text
reverse("hello")   -> olleh
reverse("Rust")    -> tsuR
reverse("")        -> (empty)
```
hints: `s.chars()` gives you the characters one by one, and `.rev()` walks them backwards.
All together: `s.chars().rev().collect()`. (A `for` loop that builds a new `String` with `result.push(c)` works too.)
explanation: `chars().rev().collect()` reads the characters backwards and builds a new `String`. Reversing characters (not bytes) is what keeps non-English letters intact.
